\paragraph{Monte Carlo.} 200 samples, process and mismatch together,
\SI{37}{\celsius}, at the conditions above. Cell-loop gain at DC averages
\SI{72.13}{\decibel} with a 1st percentile of \SI{68.67}{\decibel}, and every sample
clears the \SI{60}{\degree} phase-margin limit, the worst at \SI{80.13}{\degree}
(Figure~\ref{fig:ampab-mc-cellaol}, Table~\ref{tab:ampab-mc-cellstab}). Tracking error
at zero cell current --- the amplifier's input offset carried to the reference
electrode --- has a mean of \SI{-0.694}{\milli\volt}, a median of
\SI{-0.267}{\milli\volt} and \(\sigma = \SI{5.708}{\milli\volt}\); over the fixed
\SIrange{0.4}{2.1}{\volt} command window the worst magnitude averages
\SI{5.494}{\milli\volt} and reaches \SI{23.082}{\milli\volt}, meeting the
\SI{10}{\milli\volt} limit on \SI{87.0}{\percent} of channels and \SI{57.3}{\percent} of
four-channel chips (Table~\ref{tab:ampab-mc-tracking}). With that offset removed, load
regulation is \SI{-22.17}{\micro\volt} at \SI{+10}{\micro\ampere} and
\SI{23.97}{\micro\volt} at \SI{-10}{\micro\ampere}; all 200 samples lie inside
\(\pm\SI{1}{\milli\volt}\), for \SI{100}{\percent} per channel and over four
(Table~\ref{tab:ampab-mc-regulation}). Counter-electrode compliance is
\SI{2.4621}{\volt} at the ceiling and \SI{25.69}{\milli\volt} at the floor, spreading
\(\pm\SI{3.9}{\milli\volt}\) and \(\pm\SI{3.27}{\milli\volt}\) at \(3\sigma\)
(Table~\ref{tab:ampab-mc-compliance}).
